description.name: Entry
description.text: Grants [Tri-Element Mode (Fire, Lightning, Water)], [Damage Cap +10000], [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Edge], [Ultimate Art: Advent of Phoenix Ability Tracker] and [Ultimate Art: Advent of Phoenix Level]

description.name: Tri-Element Mode (Fire, Lightning, Water)
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire]/[Attach Lightning]/[Attach Water] after using a Fire/Lightning/Water ability

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Edge
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Ultimate Art: Advent of Phoenix (0~2), removed after using Ultimate Art: Advent of Phoenix two times

description.name: Ultimate Art: Advent of Phoenix Ability Tracker
description.text: Increases Ultimate Art: Advent of Phoenix level by 1 after using 7 Ninja abilities during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Edge]

description.name: Ultimate Art: Advent of Phoenix Level
description.text: Keeps track of Ultimate Art: Advent of Phoenix level (0~1), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Edge]
